sentences.text: Arctic Fry Oy is a cohort company registered on 2020-10-23 under the industry code 03220, freshwater aquaculture.
The tax register shows first sales on 2020-10-05 and a first hire on 2025-04-01.
The company-register shows eight board changes since 2023-02-01, the latest on 2026-06-03.
A programme-entry record dated 2026-02-09 sits on the apelago.fi site.
No funding, EU project or public contract record is on file, so investment and technology readiness are unknown.
For the fund this is a watchlist case, and the next evidence to look for is a first public funding or customer record.
